''''Moonshine' Marty''' is a [[human]] alcohol vendor located on [[Distillery Island]] in [[Gillijim's Isle]]. He is the creator of the recipe for Southsea Reserve.

==Quotes==

I'm the bootlegger who created the recipe for the famous Southsea Reserve!
